about_the_game:
Welcome to Misty Valley!
We're so happy to have you here 🌿

In this demo version, you'll get a first glimpse of the world we're crafting a cozy, peaceful valley full of charm, nature, and gentle adventures. While this isn’t the full experience we have planned, it offers a taste of the vibe and core concepts we’re building.

Features

Discover a Warm and Peaceful Valley
Misty Valley is home to a small town nestled in a rich natural landscape. Wander through the valley, meet its kind-hearted residents, and enjoy the calm rhythm of daily life. While the open sea is partially accessible in the demo, in the full game you’ll be able to sail toward distant islands and uncover new adventures across the waters.

Fishing Adventure
Test your luck and skill by fishing. Each fish has its own behavior, some may come easy, others require patience. In this demo, there's a limited fishing range, but there’s still plenty to discover beneath the surface.

Revive the Fish Market
Set up your own cozy stall, choose how to price your catch, and sell it to the locals. As you earn coins, you’ll help breathe new life into the once-forgotten market and slowly bring warmth and bustle back to the village square.

Farming & Foraging
Grow useful crops that help support your fishing trips, like bait and energy-giving ingredients. Farming adds a satisfying, hands-on flow to your daily routine as you nurture the valley’s soil and gather what you need.

Mysterious Finds
You might stumble upon curious objects hidden across the valley, relics that whisper stories from the past. These subtle mysteries offer hints of a deeper narrative that will slowly unfold as Misty Valley grows.

Relaxing Gameplay
With a cozy first-person camera view, Misty Valley invites you into its world with no stress or timers. You’re free to move at your own pace, fish, farm, explore, and enjoy the passing of time as the environment changes from morning light to starry nights.

A Story Just Beginning
The demo introduces you to the townsfolk and offers a soft entry into the story. In the full version, you'll dive deeper into the legacy of your grandfather and uncover the valley’s forgotten history through dialogue and choices with the community.

Made With Love by Two Developers

Misty Valley is a passion project created by just two people who love cozy, immersive experiences. This demo is just the beginning, and your thoughts truly matter to us.

Join our Discord server to help shape the journey ahead, share your feedback, and be part of the valley’s growing story. We’d love to hear from you!

short_description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.
